assertions.name: refined_form_at_2_2_within_0_1_pct
assertions.source: Refined Δ_coupling(2,2) = leading + 2·(Z-1)(N-1)·z²·E_0·h² = 13.1945 MeV vs target 13.20 MeV (0.042% gap).

description: Δ_coupling refinement adding a pp-nn cross-channel correlation term 2·(Z-1)·(N-1)·z²·E_0·h² to the leading form. Closes the 0.73% gap at doubly-magic ⁴He (2,2) to 0.04% — a 17× improvement — using only substrate primitives (no fitting). Inspired by PR #663's 'a = z_markov' SDP-PL finding. Single-magic anchors (2,1)/(1,2) have correlation = 0 by design ((Z-1)(N-1) = 0), preserving the leading-form prediction.
caveats: Single-anchor (2,2) verification only — cross-anchor verification on (2,1) and (1,2) pending PR #644's Δ_cat data. The pp-nn correlation term vanishes by design at single-magic anchors ((Z-1)(N-1) = 0), so the leading form prediction is preserved there. If cross-anchor data agrees, this refined form should be promoted to a proposition replacing the current conjecture (conj:delta-coupling-substrate-form).
